summary: Core & Main, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.000% Senior Notes due 2034 by its indirect subsidiary Core Main LP. The notes were sold to QIBs and non-U.S. persons under Rule 144A/Regulation S and are guaranteed on an unsecured senior basis by parent entities. Proceeds will prepay a portion of the 2028 Senior Term Loan and fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
